rdfs:label: ChatMessage
rdfs:comment: A message exchanged between a sender and recipients. Maps to the general schema:Message (which also covers email); use urn:solid:EmailMessage for email specifically.
notes: Schema.org's general `schema:Message` type — covers chat, IM, and similar real-time communication. Distinct from AS `urn:solid:Note` (microblog post). `urn:solid:EmailMessage` (schema:EmailMessage) is a subclass of this term, for email specifically. Pair with `schema:sender`, `schema:recipient`, `schema:dateSent`.

jsonld.urn:solid:text: Anyone around for a quick sync?

history.note: Comment now states the mapping is the general schema:Message; EmailMessage is a subclass, removed from notToBeConfusedWith.
